sources.notes: Listing $0.20; transaction 6.5% on item+shipping+gift wrap; Offsite Ads 12%/15%; currency conversion 2.5% when listing currency ≠ payment account currency. Last updated Oct 5, 2026.

sources.title: What are Payment Processing Fees for Selling on Etsy?
sources.notes: India: 5% + 25 INR of total sale price (incl. shipping and applicable tax).

sources.title: How to Accept Payments as a Seller in India
sources.notes: Confirms Etsy Payments India processing fee 5% + 25 INR; Indian shops cannot accept domestic sales via Etsy Payments.

sources.title: What is a Regulatory Operating Fee?
sources.notes: India regulatory operating fee listed as 0.05% on item price + shipping (+ gift wrap).

sources.title: What are the Fees and Taxes for Selling on Etsy?
sources.notes: Summarises fee types including regulatory operating fee for India.

fees.vat_gst_on_seller_fees_notes: India GST 18% may be applied by Etsy on seller fees. Etsy Help indicates sellers with a valid tax ID on file may not be charged VAT/GST on fees — treat as configurable. GST paid on fees is typically an input tax credit (recoverable), not a permanent operating cost.

assumptions: Payment processing uses the published India Etsy Payments rate (5% + ₹25), not the India-domestic Razorpay collection fee (3% + ₹10), because Indian shops cannot accept domestic Etsy Payments sales.
Listing fee is optionally amortised per modelled sale; default engine includes one listing fee allocation per unit sold.
Offsite Ads are optional and applied only when the user enables them.
